description_md: Cruise natural key (YYYY-MM-NODC); FK to `cruise`. Derived via `derive_cruise_key_on_casts()` from the resolved short cruise code + ship code.
NODC ship key; FK to `ship`. Resolved from the short cruise code's trailing ship code via `derive_cruise_key_on_casts()`.
Point geometry (WGS84) from longitude/latitude via `add_point_geom()`. NULL for schema variants with no position field (e.g. `mets_schema_raw_2012` -- see questions.csv mets_16).
CalCOFI grid cell; FK to `grid`. Derived via `assign_grid_key()`; NULL wherever `geom` is NULL.
Measurement type; FK to `measurement_type` (shared registry across bottle/ctd/dic/mets).
Numeric value of the measurement; units carried by `measurement_type`, not here.
Short cruise code as published in the source URL (YYMM plus an optional 2-character ship abbreviation, e.g. `1704SH`); the basis for `ship_key`/`cruise_key`.
`YYYY-MM` decoded from `cruise_code`; used to resolve a cruise for files whose name carries no ship abbreviation.
Which of the five source families a row was read under; part of the de-duplication key so two systems sampling the same cruise+timestamp are never collapsed.
File the row was read from; tie-breaker when the same cruise ships duplicate copies.
Why the row survived thinning: `grid` (nearest sample to an hour boundary) or `inflection` (Ramer-Douglas-Peucker kept it because conditions deviated beyond `rdp_eps`).
Same key as the `mets_measurement` row it subsets; `mets_thin` never mints new values.
